author: John Sevinsky
releaseNotes: 1.2.1: Exact-match fingerprint for TS0207 _TZ3000_k4ej3ww2 as these units report at join (outClusters 000A, no 0019), so new sensors pair with this driver instead of a best-cluster-match driver. 1.2.0: Fork of kkossev's Tuya NEO Coolcam Zigbee Water Leak Sensor 1.1.4. The offline health check is now a persistent hourly cron schedule, restored at hub start-up, Save Preferences and Configure, instead of a self-rescheduling runIn chain that could silently stop. Offline is decided from the time the sensor was last heard (falling back to Last Activity), with a 'Mark offline after' preference.
